name: Conceptual 12M
description: A large-scale image-text dataset of approximately 12 million image URLs paired with descriptive captions, introduced to support vision-and-language research. The distributed metadata provides links rather than the image data itself.
citation: Changpinyo, S., Sharma, P., Ding, N., & Soricut, R. (2021). Conceptual 12M: Pushing the Limits of Image-Text Pairing in Vision-Language Pre-training. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 3558–3568. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR46437.2021.00356

license.identifier: Not stated (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The dataset repository does not establish a single standard SPDX license covering the linked images and captions. Images are sourced from the web and may be subject to separate copyright and license terms; verify rights, attribution, and permitted use for each source before downloading, using, or redistributing.
